  547   def opposes?(idxBattler1, idxBattler2 = 0)

  553   def nearBattlers?(idxBattler1, idxBattler2)
  554     return false if idxBattler1 == idxBattler2
  555     return true if pbSideSize(0) <= 2 && pbSideSize(1) <= 2
  556     # Get all pairs of battler positions that are not close to each other
  557     pairsArray = [[0, 4], [1, 5]]   # Covers 3v1 and 1v3
  558     case pbSideSize(0)
  559     when 3
  560       case pbSideSize(1)
  561       when 3   # 3v3 (triple)
  562         pairsArray.push([0, 1])
  563         pairsArray.push([4, 5])
  564       when 2   # 3v2
  565         pairsArray.push([0, 1])
  566         pairsArray.push([3, 4])
  567       end
  568     when 2       # 2v3
  569       pairsArray.push([0, 1])
  570       pairsArray.push([2, 5])
  571     end
  572     # See if any pair matches the two battlers being assessed
  573     pairsArray.each do |pair|
  574       return false if pair.include?(idxBattler1) && pair.include?(idxBattler2)
  575     end
  576     return true
  577   end
